This file can be used to upload data into the mass maintenance, mass processing, and consolidation app. For this purpose, consider the following requirements:
Key and attribute specifications correspond to source tables rather than active tables. Content is from active tables.
Field values must exhibit raw database formatting.
Field values must not be converted (conversion exits etc.).
Column _ACTION_CODE may contain I, D, C for actions Insert, Delete or Copy. Note: This only works for dependent data, not for root objects.
Hidden columns are ignored during upload.
Worksheets with names starting with "!" are ignored entirely during upload.
Hide or delete worksheets whose names start with "!" before uploading into lower releases.
Any content in column _COMMENT specifies the entire line to be ignored during upload procedure.
Hide or delete all rows having content in column _COMMENT before uploading into lower releases.
Before deleting column _COMMENT you must delete all rows exhibiting content in this column.
To use the column _COMMENT it must be the first column in a worksheet.
